note: Set B is better because it captures the critical substrate slope (1/4" per foot) for the shower pan, which Set A misses entirely. Both sets share errors regarding the subfloor thickness (misreading a width dimension as thickness) and binding the 3/4" thickness to the edge strip instead of the MDF gable. Set A provides better context for wall board locations, but the omission of the drainage slope is a more significant engineering oversight.
remarks: Both sets invent the quote '3/4" MDF EDGE STRIP' by combining separate text elements ('EDGE STRIP' and '3/4" MDF GABLE'). Both misinterpret the 3" dimension in D1 as subfloor thickness rather than pan width/curb.
